producer: VOA - Voice of America English News

Agency wire material (AP/Reuters/AFP) is excluded by the same policy; this asset is VOA-produced (VOA byline on the page, hosted on VOA's own CDN).
transcript:
Pete: Hi! Are you Anna?
Anna: Yes! Hi there! Are you Pete?
Pete: I am Pete.
Anna: Nice to meet you.
Anna: Let's try that again. I'm Anna. Nice to meet you.
Pete: I'm Pete. "Anna" Is that A-N-A?
Anna: No. A-N-N-A
Pete: Well, Anna with two "n's" ... Welcome to ... 1400 Irving Street!
Anna: My new apartment! Yes!
notes: Served as a local static asset: reliability, speed and offline-capable core listening. Full dialogue retained as authentic input; the lesson's readable model extracts only the meet-someone exchange (see docs/curriculum/lesson-001-meet-someone.md).
